verdict: Anima drew a round robot postman, TRELLIS.2 built a textured mesh from that one picture, and Blender set it at 18 cm with its pivot at the base and turned it. From the front the mesh matches the drawing: cap, belt line, satchel, arms and boots. Two flaws: the back, which the drawing never showed, is covered in grey smudges, and the turntable frames the figure small in a 512-pixel square. Anima is non-commercial, so this figure is too.
peak_note: Peak is this run's own ComfyUI and tools, read from nvidia-smi every 2 seconds. The card was shared with other work. Time adds up each stage's own work, not the wait for the shared card.
